title: Haman’s Plot to Destroy the Jews

questions.question: Who was Haman the son of?
questions.explanation: Esther 3:1 (ESV): "...promoted Haman the Agagite, the son of Hammedatha..."

questions.question: What did the king’s servants ask Mordecai?
options: Why do you transgress the king's command?
questions.correctAnswer: Why do you transgress the king's command?
questions.explanation: Esther 3:3 (ESV): "...Why do you transgress the king's command?"

questions.question: What reason did Mordecai give for not bowing?
questions.explanation: Esther 3:4 (ESV): "...for he had told them that he was a Jew."

questions.question: To whom did Haman seek to destroy?
options: All the Jews, the people of Mordecai
questions.correctAnswer: All the Jews, the people of Mordecai
questions.explanation: Esther 3:6 (ESV): "...Haman sought to destroy all the Jews, the people of Mordecai..."

questions.question: What is the meaning of "Pur"?
questions.explanation: Esther 3:7 (ESV): "...they cast Pur (that is, they cast lots)..."

questions.question: In which month was the lot cast?
questions.explanation: Esther 3:7 (ESV): "In the first month, which is the month of Nisan..."

questions.question: For which month did the lot fall?
questions.explanation: Esther 3:7 (ESV): "...till the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar."

questions.question: How did Haman describe the Jews to the king?
options: A certain people scattered abroad... their laws are different... they do not keep the king's laws
questions.correctAnswer: A certain people scattered abroad... their laws are different... they do not keep the king's laws
questions.explanation: Esther 3:8 (ESV): "...There is a certain people scattered abroad... Their laws are different from those of every other people, and they do not keep the king's laws..."

questions.question: How much silver did Haman offer to pay?
questions.explanation: Esther 3:9 (ESV): "...I will pay 10,000 talents of silver..."

questions.question: What did the king give Haman to seal the decree?
questions.explanation: Esther 3:10 (ESV): "So the king took his signet ring from his hand and gave it to Haman..."

questions.question: On what specific day were the Jews to be annihilated?
options: The thirteenth day of the twelfth month
questions.correctAnswer: The thirteenth day of the twelfth month
questions.explanation: Esther 3:13 (ESV): "...in one day, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month..."

questions.question: What else was permitted against the Jews besides killing them?
Who went out with the decree?
questions.explanation: Esther 3:15 (ESV): "The couriers went out hurriedly by order of the king..."

questions.question: What was the reaction in the city of Susa?
options: The city of Susa was thrown into confusion
questions.correctAnswer: The city of Susa was thrown into confusion
questions.explanation: Esther 3:15 (ESV): "...but the city of Susa was thrown into confusion."

questions.question: What day were the scribes summoned to write the decree?
options: The thirteenth day of the first month
questions.correctAnswer: The thirteenth day of the first month
questions.explanation: Esther 3:12 (ESV): "Then the king's scribes were summoned on the thirteenth day of the first month..."

key_verse_text: Letters were sent by couriers to all the king's provinces with instruction to destroy, to kill, and to annihilate all Jews, young and old, women and children, in one day, the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar, and to plunder their goods.
